name: Segare no Niizuma
source:
Half a year ago, I lost my wife, my one and only, to a traffic accident.
Overwhelmed by grief, I shut myself inside my house.
And, almost as though to spite me, my son gets married to a lovely woman.
And as if that wasn't bad enough, they offer to move in with me, and I'm forced to bear witness to their happy married life.
